name: letak-worker-lidl
description: Detects Lidl leaflets under the 'Letaky' listing section and returns new leaflet URLs.
author: Fancysoft / 0ics

execute.description: Parse the Lidl leaflet listing page (and the per-leaflet flyer API for validity/PDF) and return leaflets that are not already known.

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the full result JSON should be written.

knownLeaflets.description: Leaflet keys already seen, each formatted as 'type|from|to' (e.g. 'Aktualny letak|2026-06-29|2026-07-05'). Any leaflet whose key is not in this list is reported as new.

types.description: Optional case-insensitive leaflet-type filter (e.g. ['Aktualny letak']). When set, only leaflets of these types are returned; empty or absent means all types. Combined with knownLeaflets: a leaflet is returned only when it matches a type AND is new.

pageUrl.description: Override for the leaflet listing page URL. Defaults to https://www.lidl.sk/c/online-letak/s10008489

flyerApiUrl.description: Override for the per-leaflet flyer-detail API base URL (validity + PDF link). Defaults to https://endpoints.leaflets.schwarz/v4/flyer. May contain a literal '{identifier}' placeholder (used by tests to point at local fixtures) instead of query params.

customData.description: Optional source-specific hints passed through from the scanner/orchestrator.

outputPath.description: Path to the written result JSON.

count.description: Number of returned leaflets (new AND matching the type filter).

hasNew.description: True when at least one matching new leaflet was found.

leaflets.description: Matched leaflets (new AND of a requested type), each a downloadable PDF entry.

type.description: Leaflet type (e.g. 'Aktualny letak', 'Online magazin'). Part of the novelty key.

fileSize.description: Size of the result JSON in bytes.

terminate.description: Cancel a running scrape and clean up resources.
